title: Anahat Singh Becomes 1st Indian Girl to Win World Junior Squash Championship Title
summary: Defeated Egypt's Ruqayya Salem in Canada to end Egypt's 16-year hold on the junior title.

blocks.content: Defeated Egypt's Ruqayya Salem in Canada to end Egypt's 16-year hold on the junior title.

items: Historic Context: 1st Indian finalist in over 20 years since Joshna Chinappa (2005) and 1st ever gold medallist.
Boys Event: Aryaveer Dewan reached last 16.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Anahat Singh ranked World No. 20 on senior PSA Tour | Squash to debut at LA 2028 Olympics.
